mapping.summary: Exports BC purchasing data to Tacto and imports order confirmations and vendor updates.
claims: Exports items, vendors, prices and purchase documents as CSV files
25 purchasing datasets enabled out of the box
Configurable tables, fields, field order and stacked filters
Option to export only items you actually buy
Delivery by ZIP download, Azure Blob Storage or a local server path (on-prem)
Azure Blob upload uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials with a connection test
Writes supplier confirmations of quantity, price, discount and date onto purchase orders
Respects approvals when reopening released orders
Can attach the confirmation PDF to the purchase order
Updates existing vendors and contact persons from Tacto files
Logs each imported file, rejects unclear matches and avoids double imports
New IBANs are only reported until bank account creation is allowed
Scheduled nightly export and import every 15 minutes
Configuration and mappings can be moved between companies as files
Separate permission sets for admin, export and import
Requires Business Central 24.0 or later, Essentials or Premium
